name: Vytautas Magnus University
overview:
Vytautas Magnus University (UVM), one of Lithuania's liberal higher education institutions, has a rich history and well-established traditions. Indeed, the university plays an important role not only in Lithuania, but constitutes an intellectual and cultural source for the whole Baltic region.

Founded in 1922, UVM is ranked among the 700 best universities in the world (QS World University Rankings). The UVM community now has around 9,500 students, with more than 500 professors and researchers.

The university is distinguished by its warm and sincere educational atmosphere.

administrative:
1) Application dossier

Once the IAFF office has sent your nomination, the partner university will contact you directly by email to start your application. All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline (see EMEA Teams channel for each application deadline).

If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet, please be patient.

To be completed with your Epitech bachelor campus administration during the registration period for Tech4 (usually in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract.
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier.


2) Visa

For European students, a valid passport/national ID card is sufficient to travel to Europe (exception for the UK).

For non-European students or students with a non-European citizenship, please check the immigration office of the host country to check the visa process and fees.

Students in France can use this website: https://www.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fr/


3) Insurance

For European students

The European Health Insurance Card (CEAM in French) is nominative and individual. This card certifies your rights to the Health Insurance in Europe. To obtain your card, log in to your Ameli account at least two months before your departure. It is free of charge and will be sent to your place within two weeks. You can also download it online.

For more information: https://www.ameli.fr/assure/droits-demarches/europe-international/protection-sociale-etranger/etudes-etranger

For non-European students

You must register for a private health insurance to cover your full stay. Please check with your parents, bank, or any private insurance company for more information depending on the wanted coverage.

Please register via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ariane) platform to be aware of any news (terrorist attack, tsunami, earthquake…) in your host country for French citizens only:

https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html
accomodation:
Campus life

The university has 2 dormitories, one located at 71, Kaunas (“Baltija”) and the other at A. Vivulskio g. 36, Vilnius (“Vivulskis”).

For Baltija, the rates are as follows:

  • €6 per day for a single room
  • €5 per day for a double room or for a single room in a dormitory for several people
  • €4 per day for a triple room or for a double bed in a dormitory for several people

For Vivulskis, the rates are as follows:

  • €7 per day for a single room
  • €6 for a double bed in a dormitory for several people
  • For more information, please see this link.

If you want to stay off campus, here are the typical rates:

  • One bedroom apartment in the city center: €373.78
  • One bedroom apartment outside the city center: €218.67
  • Three bedroom apartment in the city center: €543.75
  • Three bedroom apartment outside the city center: €342.50

Note that the faculty of computer science is located out of the city center where the main university building is located, so you will have to take the bus to get there.
courses:
You must obtain 30 ECTS credits per semester, i.e. 60 ECTS credits for the year among the classes validated by Epitech below:



You will find some course descriptions here:

https://www.vdu.lt/en/studies/courses/

The classes are taught in English (it is recommended to have at least a B1 level).

You will be enrolled in courses at the Faculty of Informatics. The classes are theoretical and somewhat mathematical.

The year begins the last week of August (arrival scheduled for the last week of August for a week of orientation) and goes until the end of June the following year.

You will find the academic calendar here:

https://www.vdu.lt/en/studies/international-student-handbook/

We remind you that attendance is compulsory, under penalty of exclusion from the university.

The class list is given to you for information purposes. It can change from year to year. If a course is not available when you arrive on site, EPITECH cannot be held responsible.

EIP: Any tech4 abroad involves an EIP! Take advantage of the free slots you will have to advance them.
